about_the_game:
Betrayed by blood. Your brother seized your throne, stole your power and cast your name into shadow. By chance alone you survived — but the world you knew did not.

He did not merely take a crown: he razed kingdoms, crushed dissent and laid the land to ruin. A tyrant in iron and ash, he turned cities into graves and sold the cries of the innocent to the highest bidder. Your wife was taken. Your children were torn from you and sold into chains. The realm smolders under his rule.

Now you rise as the Shadow Monarch — hollowed, hunting, remade by loss and fury. With every battle you regain a shard of power, with every choice you shape the fate of a broken world. Will you gather the scattered embers and rebuild a just realm… or fan the flames into a new order born of fire and fear?

Pursue your brother across ruined fortresses, haunted wildernesses and shattered capitals. Rescue those who remain, rally the broken, and confront the tyrant who turned kingship into tyranny — or seize the throne and bend this blasted world to your will. The path is yours: savior, avenger, or sovereign of ash.

Every encounter tests you. Every decision scars the world — and the world will remember which kind of Monarch you chose to be. Whatare you gonna choose?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows® 8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Additional Notes: * Ab dem 1. Januar 2024 unterstützt der Steam-Client nur noch Windows 10 und neuere Versionen.

short_description: Shadow Monarch’s Rise is a soulslike action RPG with fast, skill-based combat, many many quests, hidden treasures, epic bosses, and character progression. A Skilltree with epic Powers to unlock! Future updates will include more Skills, areas, Co-Op Gameplay & Bosses who r gonna make u suffer!
